goalExpressionRepair.originalStatement:
import Mathlib

open scoped Real
open EuclideanSpace

def formalStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (A B C D E F P Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
  let cross2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ :=
    fun X Y => X 0 * Y 1 - X 1 * Y 0;
  let angle : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ :=
    fun X Y => Real.arccos (inner X Y / (‖X‖ * ‖Y‖));
  cross2 (B - A) (C - B) > 0 ∧
  cross2 (C - B) (D - C) > 0 ∧
  cross2 (D - C) (A - D) > 0 ∧
  cross2 (A - D) (B - A) > 0 ∧
  angle (B - A) (C - A) = angle (C - A) (D - A) ∧
  (∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ E = (1 - t) • B + t • C) ∧
  (∃ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧ F = (1 - s) • C + s • D) ∧
  (∃ k : ℝ, F - E = k • (D - B)) ∧
  (∃ p : ℝ, p < 0 ∧ P - A = p • (F - A)) ∧
  (∃ q : ℝ, q < 0 ∧ Q - A = q • (E - A)) ∧
  (∃ (O1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r1 : ℝ),
    0 < r1 ∧ dist O1 A = r1 ∧ dist O1 B = r1 ∧ dist O1 P = r1 ∧
      inner (O1 - A) (C - A) = 0) ∧
  (∃ (O2 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r2 : ℝ),
    0 < r2 ∧ dist O2 A = r2 ∧ dist O2 D = r2 ∧ dist O2 Q = r2 ∧
      inner (O2 - A) (C - A) = 0) →
  ∃ (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ),
    0 < r ∧ dist O B = r ∧ dist O P = r ∧ dist O Q = r ∧ dist O D = r
goalExpressionRepair.modelEncodingNotes: 使用 Real 平面坐标模型。凸四边形用连续边向量叉积同号（正或负）编码；角平分用向量夹角相等编码；E,F 在线段 BC,CD 上用参数 t,s∈[0,1] 编码；EF∥BD 用非零标量 EF = k·BD 编码；P,Q 在 FA,EA 越过 A 的延长线上用 p,q<0 编码；两圆过相应三点且与 AC 在 A 相切，用存在圆心和半径、三点到圆心等距、半径 OA 垂直 AC 编码；结论 B,P,Q,D 共圆用存在圆心和半径经过四点编码。
goalExpressionRepair.candidateFormalStatement: let cross2 : (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → Real) := fun X Y => X 0 * Y 1 - X 1 * Y 0; let angle : (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → Real) := fun X Y => Real.arccos (inner X Y / (‖X‖ * ‖Y‖)); let isConvexQuad : (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → Prop) := fun A B C D => ((cross2 (B - A) (C - B) > 0 ∧ cross2 (C - B) (D - C) > 0 ∧ cross2 (D - C) (A - D) > 0 ∧ cross2 (A - D) (B - A) > 0) ∨ (cross2 (B - A) (C - B) < 0 ∧ cross2 (C - B) (D - C) < 0 ∧ cross2 (D - C) (A - D) < 0 ∧ cross2 (A - D) (B - A) < 0)); ∀ (A B C D E F P Q : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)), (isConvexQuad A B C D ∧ angle (B - A) (C - A) = angle (C - A) (D - A) ∧ (∃ t : Real, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ E = (1 - t) • B + t • C) ∧ (∃ s : Real, 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧ F = (1 - s) • C + s • D) ∧ (∃ k : Real, k ≠ 0 ∧ F - E = k • (D - B)) ∧ (∃ p : Real, p < 0 ∧ P - A = p • (F - A)) ∧ (∃ q : Real, q < 0 ∧ Q - A = q • (E - A)) ∧ (∃ (O1 : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (r1 : Real), 0 < r1 ∧ dist O1 A = r1 ∧ dist O1 B = r1 ∧ dist O1 P = r1 ∧ inner (O1 - A) (C - A) = 0) ∧ (∃ (O2 : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (r2 : Real), 0 < r2 ∧ dist O2 A = r2 ∧ dist O2 D = r2 ∧ dist O2 Q = r2 ∧ inner (O2 - A) (C - A) = 0)) → ∃ (O : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (r : Real), 0 < r ∧ dist O B = r ∧ dist O P = r ∧ dist O Q = r ∧ dist O D = r
